texts.Route131_Text_1C25B3: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.$
texts.Route131_Text_1C25F8: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough...$
texts.Route131_Text_1C262A: Gasp... Gasp... I'm wiped out...\pThe going's easy. It's the leaving\nthat's the hard part.\pWill I have any energy left to make\nthe return trip?$

texts.Route131_Text_1C26B9: The sea... The sea... The sea...\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\lI'm sick and tired of the sea!$
texts.Route131_Text_1C2726: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\pI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.$

texts.Route131_Text_1C2774: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!$
texts.Route131_Text_1C27A4: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!$
texts.Route131_Text_1C27CF: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\pThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!$

texts.Route131_Text_1C284A: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\pThey all ogle me!$
texts.Route131_Text_1C2898: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!$

texts.Route131_Text_1C28E2: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!$
texts.Route131_Text_1C2918: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together...$
texts.Route131_Text_1C29B2: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.$
texts.Route131_Text_1C2950: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\lthe time they are born.$

texts.Route131_Text_1C29F3: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!$
texts.Route131_Text_1C2A20: IAN: I did my best with my sis, but\nwe still couldn't win...$
texts.Route131_Text_1C2ACA: IAN: If you have two POKéMON, we'll\ntake you on!$
texts.Route131_Text_1C2A5D: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\pSo, wherever there is the sea, that's\na part of PACIFIDLOG!$
